page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.sn2.xlarge delivers modest performance relative to modern hardware profiles. Its single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories respectively. Memory read bandwidth is also relatively weak, though large-block memory write bandwidth achieves average tier results. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3 single-threaded operations, register in the bottom 10% of tested systems. However, the instance maintains average performance in Passmark CPU tests and small-model LLM inference tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.xlarge offers a dedicated resource allocation without the premium of high-frequency compute or specialized storage hardware. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-heavy operations. Given its balanced resource ratio but lower-tier benchmark performance, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads with moderate resource demands, such as lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, development environments, and small-scale database operations that do not require high IOPS or rapid CPU execution.
